comments: Replace with any overall comment. Approving this plan also settles the two open questions in section 4 of the review: that no acceptance criterion in scope is API-verifiable this release (CLR-TP-ETA-411-001), and that the unauthenticated scenario asserts the presence of an error message rather than its wording (CLR-TP-ETA-411-002). Say so here if you disagree with either.

itemDecisions.comment: The six named modules are offered. Presence only; openability is carried by TS-002, TS-003 and TS-005. UI.
The three Dashboard icons each open their module. UI.
The three navigation menu entries each open their module. Kept separate from TS-002 because both entry points exist for the same two modules. UI.
Preferences is offered with Organization and Vault beneath it. Presence only, per your answer that Preferences is a grouping rather than a destination. UI.
Organization and Vault open their own pages. Arrival asserted on page content because Organization shares a destination with the Preferences icon. UI.
Command Center returns to Home from each module. Will need a VALIDATED locator waiver; the control has no accessible name. UI.
An unauthenticated visitor is refused and kept on the sign-in page. No credential is entered, so no lockout risk. Message wording not asserted. UI.
